description: This file defines the 'Counter' metric type for Prometheus client in Go, including interfaces, constructors, and methods for creating and manipulating counters, counter vectors, and counter functions.

classes.name: counter
classes.description: Implementation of the Counter interface, managing internal state and providing methods for incrementing, adding, and writing metric data.

classes.name: CounterVec
classes.description: A collection of Counters partitioned by variable labels, allowing for efficient management of multiple related counters.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a non-negative value to the counter, panics if the value is negative.

methods.name: AddWithExemplar
methods.description: Adds a value to the counter and updates the exemplar with provided labels.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the counter as a float64.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Populates the provided DTO Metric with the current counter value and exemplar.

methods.name: updateExemplar
methods.description: Updates the exemplar with the given value and labels.

methods.name: NewCounter
methods.description: Creates a new Counter instance with specified options.

methods.name: NewCounterVec
methods.description: Creates a new CounterVec with specified options and label names.

methods.name: GetMetricWithLabelValues
methods.description: Returns the Counter for the specified label values.

methods.name: GetMetricWith
methods.description: Returns the Counter for the specified labels map.

methods.name: WithLabelValues
methods.description: Returns the Counter for the specified label values, panics on error.

methods.name: With
methods.description: Returns the Counter for the specified labels, panics on error.

methods.name: CurryWith
methods.description: Returns a new CounterVec curried with the provided labels.

methods.name: MustCurryWith
methods.description: Returns a new CounterVec curried with the provided labels, panics on error.

methods.name: NewCounterFunc
methods.description: Creates a new CounterFunc that determines its value at collection time via a provided function.
